claims.value: aquaporin water channels in the apical membrane (inserted when ADH stimulates the cell)
claims.quote: When stimulated by ADH, aquaporin channels are inserted into the apical membrane of principal cells, which line the collecting ducts.

source.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

claims.value: Na+/K+ ATPase pumps on the basal membrane
claims.quote: Aldosterone stimulates principal cells to manufacture luminal Na+ and K+ channels as well as Na+/K+ ATPase pumps on the basal membrane of the cells.

source.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

claims.value: Aquaporin proteins moved into its apical membrane form water channels, letting water pass through the cell from the collecting-duct lumen into the interstitial space of the medulla by osmosis.
claims.quote: stimulating the movement of aquaporin proteins into the apical cell membrane of principal cells of the collecting ducts to form water channels, allowing the transcellular movement of water from the lumen of the collecting duct into the interstitial space in the medulla of the kidney by osmosis.

source.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

claims.value: Its channels for sodium and potassium let the principal cell either recover or lose these two ions.
claims.quote: A principal cell possesses channels for the recovery or loss of sodium and potassium.

source.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

claims.value: Aldosterone has the cell build luminal Na+ and K+ channels and basal Na+/K+ ATPase pumps, so more Na+ is recovered from the forming urine and water follows it passively.
claims.quote: Aldosterone stimulates principal cells to manufacture luminal Na+ and K+ channels as well as Na+/K+ ATPase pumps on the basal membrane of the cells. When aldosterone output increases, more Na+ is recovered from the forming urine and water follows the Na+ passively.

source.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

claims.value: Further channels in the cell secrete K+ into the collecting duct in direct proportion to how much Na+ it recovers.
claims.quote: Still other channels in the principal cells secrete K+ into the collecting duct in direct proportion to the recovery of Na+.

source.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.
